title: Attach links to worktrees
body:
A worktree can now carry saved links — the pull request it opened, a staging URL, a ticket — as rows of the SESSIONS PANEL's PULL REQUESTS group.

Enter on a row hands the URL to the browser; the detected pull request is found by `gh pr view` on the branch and needs no saving at all.

A saved link that *is* the pull request is shown once, as the pull-request row, so the same destination never appears twice.

comments.body: Tried it on a branch with no PR yet — the group stays empty until one opens, which is what I'd expect.
Right — and the first GIT POLL after `gh pr create` picks it up without a restart.

reviews.body: Reads well; one nit on the dedupe inline.
